title_zh: 说清演讲失误后的感受

scenario.label_zh: 讨论演讲失误后的支持方式
scenario.goal_zh: 倾听演讲失误后的感受并约定不打断的练习方式。

context_zh: 朋友在一次社区演讲后聊天，讲者想重新练习但担心再次卡住。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: That pause in my talk was so embarrassing. I forgot the name of the street I grew up on.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: It felt longer to you than it did to us. You found it again.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Eventually, yes. But I was still embarrassed when I sat down.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: How do you feel about it now?

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Relief is the strongest emotion. I got through the talk instead of walking away.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: Would it help to try the opening again with just me listening?

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Yes, but I dislike being interrupted every time I hesitate. Please let me finish before giving feedback.

sentences.speaker: Miles
sentences.text: I can do that. We can practise tomorrow, and I will keep my notes until the end.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Thank you. That feels like a useful next step, not another test.
